Portions of src/world/drainage.js adapt assignDownslope and assignFlow from map.ts.
Modifications include regular grid adjacency, outlet-only roots, priority-flood
spill surfaces, grid-index parents, and distance-weighted grade.

Pixel Plays
Copyright (c) 2026 Amir Mushich
https://github.com/amirmushichge/pixel-plays/tree/0c2a70f
MIT. See Pixel-Plays-MIT.txt.
The Bayer threshold arrangement in engine.js is expressed in GLSL in the renderer.
Stari Most's staggered masonry and two-arc arch profile informed the castle
material and gate geometry. The castle uses WebGL meshes and a stone shader.
